verdict.rationale: Penpot publishes a documented integrations API (access tokens, webhooks, plugin API) and a first-party MCP server, and a runtime probe confirms the self-hosted MCP service actually completes a full JSON-RPC handshake and exposes tools for AI agents to drive the product — this goes beyond vendor claims to verified working behavior. Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s found) and independent third-party developer accounts of building against the API.
